card: This draft RFC enables `-Wunused` compiler warning flags in CMake to prevent dead code and unused parameters from accumulating unnoticed. Without these warnings enabled in CI, unused variables and parameters build up across the repository, occasionally masking omissions where intended logic was forgotten (such as #36137). The pull request resolves existing warnings across 160 files through parameter name omissions, attribute annotations, and RPC argument extraction refactors. It depends on upstream subtree updates to Minisketch, libmultiprocess, and LevelDB before it can be merged.
changed_since_previous: Added commits refactoring RPC parameter extraction to use the `self.Arg<>()` helper and altering RPC parameter alias handling in `GetParamIndex` and `verifychain`.
evidence: The PR description points to a batch of eight recent dead-code removal PRs (#35679, #35910, #35914, etc.) as evidence of clutter accumulating.
The description cites #36137 as a case where code thought to be dead was actually a forgotten call that should have been used.
problem: The build system does not enforce `-Wunused`, allowing dead code and unused parameters to accumulate unnoticed. This can hide bugs where code or parameters were accidentally forgotten rather than intentionally unused.

risk.why: Unintended regressions in the RPC argument extraction refactoring could break parameter parsing or change legacy alias handling for RPC users.

scope_notes: This draft RFC includes three `[[nomerge]]` commits with fixes intended for upstream subtrees (LevelDB, Minisketch, and libmultiprocess). It also contains a refactor of RPC argument processing across several RPC commands alongside widespread mechanical parameter stripping.
summary: Enables the `-Wunused` compiler warning flag and related flags in the CMake build system. It resolves existing compiler warnings across 160 files by omitting unused parameter names, tagging them with `[[maybe_unused]]`, refactoring RPC argument retrieval to use the `Arg<>()` helper, and applying temporary fixes to subtree code.
